dualEnergyArchitectureEvidence.description: Manual documents gas cooktop and electric oven as separately serviceable domains under shared control architecture
dualEnergyArchitectureEvidence.diagramObserved: Main PCB / Display PCB orchestrate oven electric relays (bake/broil/convection) while cooktop gas path routes through spark module, valve cooktop, ignition switches, and burners
dualEnergyArchitectureEvidence.surfacePath: knob → switch ignition (LITE) → spark module → electrode → valve cooktop → burner
dualEnergyArchitectureEvidence.ovenPath: touch/knob UI → Main PCB relays (RY202 broil, RY203 bake, RY207 convection heater, SSR200/201 convection fan) → electric heaters
dualEnergyArchitectureEvidence.sharedLayer: terminal block power, Main PCB + Sub/Display PCB, CNS600 sensor/switch bus, thermal/ door-lock paths
dualEnergyArchitectureEvidence.falsificationQuestion: Does combining gas surface and electric oven create a functional dependency the frozen contract cannot represent?
dualEnergyArchitectureEvidence.observationalAnswer: Not evidenced on R1 — troubleshooting decomposes into §4-2 control/oven paths vs §4-3 cooktop gas paths without requiring a new canonical node

power_supply_dual_fuel.implementationEvidence: §4-1 symptom matrix p.64: measure input voltage 240/120V or 208/120V at terminal block (L1 BLK, N WHT, L2 RED); CNP100 L1~N 120V on main PCB; gas supply valve prerequisite for cooktop (§4-3 p.72–73). Safety: disconnect gas and electric before service (§1-2 p.4).
power_supply_dual_fuel.functionalMapping: Dual supply prerequisite (electric branch + gas line) is independently verified before PCB/heater/ignition paths — maps to frozen power_supply functional role.

control_board_dual_fuel.implementationEvidence: Main PCB + Display/Sub PCB architecture; §6-3 Main PCB relay map p.88–89: RY202 broil, RY203 bake, RY207 convection heater, SSR200/201 convection fan, RY210 door lock; §6-4 CNS200 Main-Sub communication p.90; cooktop gas path separate: §3-9 Spark Module p.29, §3-17 Valve Cooktop p.37–38, §3-18 Switch Ignition p.39; §4-2 control parts p.69–71; C-21 checks bake/broil/convection relays separately from cooktop faults.
control_board_dual_fuel.functionalMapping: control_board orchestrates both domains but manual keeps gas surface ignition/valve/burner diagnostics separate from oven electric relay/heater diagnostics — no collapse into single inseparable function.
control_board_dual_fuel.topologyNotCanonical: control_board → spark module/valve cooktop (gas surface) AND control_board → bake/broil/convection relays (electric oven) recorded as implementation — not promoted to canonical topology.

user_interface_dual_fuel.implementationEvidence: §2-3/2-4 control panels p.10–11: glass touch oven UI + physical cooktop knobs; §6-2 Touch Keypad p.87; C-d0 key short / knob jam (p.58); §4-2 touch keypad flows p.70; CNS801 touch film, CNS550 knob dial.
user_interface_dual_fuel.functionalMapping: UI/command interaction spans oven touch and cooktop knobs but remains a representable user_interface domain — separate from heater and ignition hardware paths.

temperature_sensor_dual_fuel.implementationEvidence: C-20 oven sensor open/short (p.54–55): 1080Ω at room temp at sensor and CNS600 on Main PCB; §3-23 Sensor-Thermistor p.45; oven sensor resistance chart p.54; upper/lower sensor pins on CNS600 (pins 4-6 / 8-10).
temperature_sensor_dual_fuel.functionalMapping: Electric oven cavity temperature feedback is independently measured and fault-routed — same functional role as frozen temperature_sensor on the oven domain.

surface_heating_system_dual_fuel.implementationEvidence: Gas cooktop: 5 burners, electronic ignition (§2-4 p.11, §464–473 p.11); §3-6 Assy Cooktop Burner p.25; §3-9 Spark Module p.29; §3-17 Valve Cooktop p.37–38; §3-18 Switch Ignition p.39; §4-3 Cooktop parts p.72–77: spark module voltage, ignition switch LITE position, electrode, gas pressure regulator, manifold, orifice cleaning — separate from oven electric heater troubleshooting.
surface_heating_system_dual_fuel.functionalMapping: Cooktop heat generation remains independently diagnosable functional domain — manual decomposes surface problems into ignition/spark/valve/burner/orifice paths. Frozen surface_heating_system expresses gas surface heating; valve, spark module, igniter, burner, GPR are platform vocabulary.

scrutinyNotes.notEquivalentBecause: Gas surface spark-ignition/valve/burner path is not equivalent to electric radiant or induction — manual tests gas-specific hardware.
scrutinyNotes.falsificationQuestion: Does dual-fuel architecture require a canonical node beyond surface_heating_system for gas cooktop?
scrutinyNotes.observationalAnswer: Not evidenced on R1 — cooktop faults addressable as surface heat-generation failures with platform gas vocabulary; oven electric paths remain separate.
scrutinyNotes.topologyNotCanonical: control → ignition switch → spark module → valve → burner recorded as implementation — not canonical topology.

bake_instance_scope_dual_fuel.implementationEvidence: §3-27 Heater-Bake p.52; §2-5 Bake Element 3000W p.12; §4-1 C-21 checks bake heater resistance; §4-1 symptom p.64: Bake Heater 19Ω, separate from broil 13Ω and conv 44Ω; §6-3 RY203 Bake Relay p.88.
bake_instance_scope_dual_fuel.functionalMapping: Electric bake oven heat function is independently testable (separate heater, relay, resistance spec) while cooktop is gas — maps to bake_heating_element instance scope.

broil_instance_scope_dual_fuel.implementationEvidence: §3-26 Heater-Broil p.51; §2-5 Broil Element 4200W p.12; §4-1 symptom p.64: Broil Heater 13Ω; §6-3 RY202 Broil Relay p.88; C-A2 uses Broil Hi mode to verify cooling fan p.63.
broil_instance_scope_dual_fuel.functionalMapping: Electric broil oven heat function is independently testable — separate from bake and from gas cooktop — maps to broil_heating_element instance scope.

convection_heating_element_dual_fuel.implementationEvidence: §2-5 Convection Heater 1,300W True Convection p.12; §4-1 symptom p.64: Conv.Heater 44Ω; §6-3 RY207 Convection Heater Relay p.88; Convection Bake/Roast modes p.13.
convection_heating_element_dual_fuel.functionalMapping: Dedicated electric convection heating element with separate resistance test and relay path — conditional instance scope binds on this platform.
convection_heating_element_dual_fuel.conditionalScopeNote: Evidenced on this configuration — distinct from CG-11 gas NO_EVIDENCE case.

convection_fan_dual_fuel.implementationEvidence: §4-1 symptom p.65: Convection fan not spinning — CNP200 harness, SSR200/RY211 and SSR201/RY212 relays, fan motor 25–30Ω; §6-3 SSR200/SSR201 Upper/Lower Convection Fan relays p.88.
convection_fan_dual_fuel.functionalMapping: Convection fan actuator is independently diagnosable from convection heater relay — frozen convection_fan conditional concept applies.

thermal_protection_dual_fuel.implementationEvidence: C-21 oven heating over (p.56–57): sensor, bake/broil/convection heater and relay checks; C-A2 display PCB ambient overtemp with cooling fan check (p.63); §4-1 thermostat 0Ω normal (p.64); information codes reference Control PBA NTC sensor and cooling system (p.54).
thermal_protection_dual_fuel.functionalMapping: Thermal protection evidenced through multiple platform-specific paths (oven overtemp, display PCB overtemp/cooling fan, thermostat) — fits frozen CONDITIONAL posture without assuming single implementation across gas surface + electric oven.

oven_door_switch_dual_fuel.implementationEvidence: C-d1 door lock malfunction (p.59–60): lock motor resistance 1.75–1.95kΩ, AC 120V at motor, door lock switch; §3-20 Assy Door Latch p.42; §3-21 Switch-Door Plunger p.43; RY210 Door Lock Relay on Main PCB p.88.
oven_door_switch_dual_fuel.functionalMapping: Door-state authorization evidenced via latch motor + lock switch packaging — same conditional posture as electric/gas/induction witnesses.
